# Ancora Pens

> Ancora Pens: Italian luxury pen artisan since 1919, crafting bespoke writing instruments and premium stationery with heritage craftsmanship.

Ancora is a prestigious Italian pen manufacturer founded in 1919 by Giuseppe Zanini in Bologna, specializing in limited-edition fountain pens, rollerball pens, and collectible writing instruments. The brand combines historical inspiration, artistic design, and Italian artisanal quality across multiple signature collections.

## Core Collections

- [All Products](https://ancora1919.it/collections/all): Complete product catalog featuring pens, notebooks, and accessories
- [Limited Edition](https://ancora1919.it/collections/limited-edition): Ultra-rare pens with marble, lava, Titanic wood: Big 5, Cappella
- [Art Deco Series](https://ancora1919.it/collections/art-deco-series): Art Deco 1920s-inspired pens: Gatsby, Gentleman, Imperio designs
- [Classic Series](https://ancora1919.it/collections/classic-series): Classic series since 1960: Perla Capri and Vezuvio fountain pens
- [Elegance Series](https://ancora1919.it/collections/elegance-series): Classic Elegance series: limited 888-piece rollerball pen collection
- [Art Pieces Series](https://ancora1919.it/collections/art-pieces-series): Art-inspired pens: Medici, Columbus, Taj Mahal fountain and rollerball
- [Big 5 Series](https://ancora1919.it/collections/big-5-series): Big 5 wildlife-themed luxury pens: Rhino and Elephant collection
- [Great Persons](https://ancora1919.it/collections/great-persons): Limited-edition pens honoring Michelangelo, Watt, and historical figures
